_readme: ONE canonical list of community channel strings, read by every surface that
renders or filters the community feed.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. community_posts.channel is a plain TEXT column — the
Hebrew label IS the key. Nothing in the database constrains it, and every
surface filters with an exact string compare:
web/lib/community.ts        CHANNELS      (the source of truth)
lib/pages/community/community_widget.dart  _channels
site/build.js               COMMUNITY_CHANNELS  -> data-channel attributes
site/script.js              paintFeed()   -> p.channel === activeChannel
They drifted on ONE codepoint and silently partitioned the community. The
abroad channel was written three ways — 'חו״ל' with the Hebrew gershayim
U+05F4 (canonical), 'חו"ל' with an ASCII quote U+0022, and bare 'חול' with no
punctuation. All three look nearly identical in Hebrew, none of them compares
equal, and the post's channel column stores whichever one its writer used. A
post filed from the app under the ASCII spelling simply does not exist inside
the web channel, and vice versa. Nothing errors; the feed just says
'אין עדיין פוסטים בערוץ הזה'.
So the spellings now live HERE, once, and the tests compare them CODEPOINT BY
CODEPOINT (web/lib/__tests__/community-channels.test.ts). A byte-level test is
the whole point: an assertion that passes with a smart quote swapped for an
ASCII quote would not have caught the bug that created this file.
CHANGING THE LIST. Edit web/lib/community.ts and this file in the same commit,
then run the web suite — the test fails on any divergence, in either direction.
A channel added on one surface only is a channel whose posts are invisible
everywhere else.
FIELDS.
channels            the 7 real channels, in display order. Stored verbatim in
community_posts.channel.
all_channel         the 'everything' filter label. A UI-only sentinel — it is
NEVER written to the channel column, so it is not a member
of `channels`.
category_to_channel catalogue category id -> channel, for the
'דברו על זה בקהילה' deep-link. Unmapped ids (electricity,
…) fall back to 'המלצות'. Note abroad maps to the CHANNELS
label 'חו״ל', not to the catalogue's own 'חבילות חו״ל'.
legacy_variants     off-canonical spellings OBSERVED in shipped code, mapped to
the canonical string. This is a repair table, not a list of
accepted values: site/script.js folds them before comparing,
and supabase/community-channel-normalise-2026-07.sql rewrites
the stored rows. Nothing may WRITE a variant.
